name: stagger-reveal
purpose: Reveal a short collection in sequence while keeping each item in its final document flow position.

cwvImpact.rationale: Several stable children transition only opacity and transform with bounded semantic delays.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: Stops all item motion and leaves every item visible in its final state.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: Only opacity and transform may transition on collection items.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: Each item uses a bounded host semantic duration token and bounded stagger delay.
cwvTripwire.durationCap: Duration and stagger delays use host semantic duration tokens.
